title: Fact catalog v1 (E-002 §3; owner decision 9.1)
description: Versioned logical facts that clause conditions and edge-case recipes use, for any domain. A project scope (Authoring) declares facts for suggestions; an environment version (Studio) declares the facts its cases supply at runtime; a template maps one to the other (template.v1 policies.policy_bindings). Logical facts never name a template field.

owner.description: Who declares it: an Authoring project scope, or a Studio environment version (its facts come from case data).

factId.description: A logical fact name, domain-neutral: governing_state, audience, channel, approval_recorded.

cardinality.description: KYC Judgment v1 (optional; default one): many means each case or party has a set of values. A condition's eq and in hold when any value matches; ne and not_in when none does. An empty set is a value (none), not absence.

derivation.description: KYC Judgment v1 (optional): the fact is computed by Studio from fields the agent sees when the registry case is written, never stored as a field in the agent's data. method names the computation; inputs are collection.field paths; parameters hold its settings (for example a window in days), so changing them is a catalog version, not code.

operators.description: Operators a condition may use on this fact (clause-condition.v1). Omitted: every operator valid for the type.

availability.description: case_data: known before the episode (resolved at admission). episode_evidence: known only from what happened (resolved after the episode from sealed evidence).

source.description: Environment catalogs only: where each case's value is read. A case_data fact reads a field of the case's root record or a related collection; an episode_evidence fact reads a verifier-blocks evidence path.
